description: Create a sales summary spreadsheet in WPS Spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/sales_data.xlsx which contains raw sales transaction data with columns: Date, Product, Category, Quantity, Unit Price, Region, Salesperson. Create a summary sheet that shows: (1) Total sales by Product (SUMIF formula), (2) Total sales by Category (SUMIF formula), (3) Total sales by Region (SUMIF formula), (4) Average quantity by Product (AVERAGEIF formula), (5) Count of transactions by Salesperson (COUNTIF formula). Format the summary with bold headers, appropriate number formatting for currency. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
